test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘FRIGHT’ is written as ‘FOCQED’ and ‘SHREDS’ is written as ‘OEPPAB’. How will ‘UPSETS’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'FRIGHT’ is written as ‘FOCQED',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/feda397eab02e91ea8b51af7b9f83785f811e7385e83a15f69ce5fbc039aa8a3.png] 

‘SHREDS’ is written as ‘OEPPAB’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/560fcb62865d87fa0962a42ba225a025f6f151a7a4d2e0c98bdaca568fce27e9.png] 

Similarly, for '**UPSETS**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5c22e49c1c2fdc63925b1f519cca5655ee8db98ea04c63ebde15d4bd78a0329.png] 

So, 'UPSETS' will be written as '**PMRPQB**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
